utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can walk Hana through the loose front gate, the porch light, and the cracked step by the driveway.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good, I’ll keep the supply list tight and make sure we have what’s needed for those repairs.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive locations sorted, and I can pass along what folks need. If Noah needs a hand, send him my way.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Opal. I’ll keep pointing folks your way and spread the word when I can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do. I’ll keep sending folks your way, and if Noah needs anything, I can catch him up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren's on the leftover repairs, and he can help Vik or Rey if they need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Right, and Jules still needs folks to spread the word about the drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: And Tess is checking the time window, so we should know when she can loop Pia in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll point you to the repair drive and catch you up if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — point me over there and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, let’s head there now and I’ll catch you up on the way.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like Cleo’s got the supplies covered, and if Leo points Noah over, they should be set to help finish the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, sounds like they’re all lined up for it this week. I’ll keep an ear out and pass along the time window once I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like they’ve got it in hand; I’ll keep an ear out too and pass along anything I hear about the timing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: It’s at the right slot now. I’ll wait on Faye for the time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll take the mower belt and keep the wrench and socket set ready for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m here to help with whatever’s left on the repair drive, Rey. If you’ve got a spot for me or Vik, I can jump in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That should cover it. Rosa’s keeping the list tidy, and Faye can help coordinate if you need another hand.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, I’ll stay on it and help wherever Rosa and Faye need me.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s at the right slot now, and I’ll wait for Quinn’s list so we can tackle the repair drive together.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate too, and Bo can lend a hand on the repair drive. Send me Quinn’s list when it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m holding off until Tess confirms the time window, so we don’t send Noah to the wrong slot.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That works. I’ll keep the list tidy for Sunday at the community center, and Cleo can stay on supplies while I help out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, as long as Tess confirms first. I’d rather not send Noah off until we know the window for sure.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, the repair drive is at the right slot now, and I can point Noah to it once Opal passes along the locations.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll keep an eye out and help point Noah over once the locations come through.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Right, then let's keep the list clear: front gate, porch light, and the cracked step still need attention, and I heard the bike and chair can be looked at too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm we’re still focused on the bike and chair for the repair drive, with Rosa’s list keeping things organized?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, we’re still focused on the bike and chair, and Rosa’s list can keep the rest organized.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m sending Mara the list now, and I’ve been spreading the word so folks know the repair drive is on. Uli said he’ll try to stop by too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it. Bo, Faye, Vik, and Rey are still the folks I’d keep on the helper list, and Bo can help coordinate if needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll keep Bo, Faye, Vik, and Rey on the helper list, and I’ll send Mara the full update now.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I think Bo, Vik, and Rey are on the helper list, and Faye may be coordinating. Does that match what you have?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, that matches what I have. I can also point Noah to the repair drive so he can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, that matches. And Noah can help spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m just checking who still needs help on the repair drive, and when Tess hears back on the time window, I want Pia looped in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate it, and Bo can help with the repair drive too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good to know. Tell me when Tess has the time window, and I’ll make sure Pia gets it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I appreciate you keeping an eye on it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’ll keep an eye out. If I miss anything, Leo can catch me up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oren, you’re still here if there’s anything left on the repair drive. Rosa has the list organized, and Vik can check in with the others.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I’m still here. Point me at whatever’s left on the repair drive and I’ll help finish it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, then let’s start with whatever’s still open and I’ll keep the list moving.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m still spreading the word and sending Mara the list of what needs attention. Uli said he’ll try to stop by, too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, keep that list moving, and I’ll point Noah to the right slot once Opal sends over the locations.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, they’re taking appliances, bikes, and small furniture this week, and I’ll pass along the time window to Pia as soon as I hear it back.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, that’s the word for now, and I’ll let Pia know the window as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm still waiting on Tess to confirm the time window before I send Noah over.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Gus and Bo can keep spreading the word. Vik can cover the rest if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Right, but I still need Tess to confirm the window before I send Noah anywhere.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Rey, I’ve got the repair drive locations sorted and can pass along what’s needed. If Noah needs catching up, point him my way.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Opal. If Rosa can keep the list tidy and Faye can help coordinate, we should be set.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ll keep the repair drive locations straight and pass along anything needed. Send Jules my way too if someone needs connecting.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Right, I heard Faye’s passing the word to Bo, and Jules wants help spreading it around too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can take care of whatever’s left on the repair drive, and I’ll loop Oren in if we need extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Good, then the word should get around and the rest can settle into place.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s on Sunday at the community center, and I’ll keep the list tidy. If Cleo needs a hand with supplies, I’m ready.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Right, and we still need someone to look at the front gate, porch light, and that cracked step. I’ll keep an eye on the list too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Eli. I’ll keep the list current, and we can note those three spots for Leo to review.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Cleo's got the supplies handled, and with Rosa and Vik on it, the repair drive should be set. If Leo sees Noah, he can point him over to help.
